description: This file contains the CellMatcher class, which is responsible for evaluating conditional formatting rules in spreadsheet cells within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages various types of conditional rules, processes cell references, and evaluates formulas related to conditional formatting conditions.

classes.name: CellMatcher
classes.description: This class is used to evaluate conditional formatting rules and conditions on individual cells within a worksheet, supporting various comparison types, including range and duplicate checks, and handling complex expressions for conditional formatting evaluation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CellMatcher with a specific cell and conditional range, setting up necessary context and calculation engine.

methods.name: setReferenceCellForExpressions
methods.description: Sets the reference cell and converts the conditional range into absolute coordinates suitable for formula expressions.

methods.name: evaluateConditional
methods.description: Evaluates a given conditional object to determine if the cell meets the condition.

methods.name: wrapValue
methods.description: Wraps a value appropriately for inclusion in a formula expression, handling strings, booleans, nulls, and numbers.

methods.name: wrapCellValue
methods.description: Returns the calculated value of the cell, wrapped for formula evaluation.

methods.name: conditionCellAdjustment
methods.description: Adjusts cell references within conditions based on relative positions and optional worksheet context.

methods.name: cellConditionCheck
methods.description: Processes condition strings to replace cell references with their calculated values within formulas.

methods.name: adjustConditionsForCellReferences
methods.description: Applies cell reference adjustments to an array of conditions.

methods.name: processOperatorComparison
methods.description: Processes comparison operators (e.g., greater than, equal to) for conditional evaluation.

methods.name: processRangeOperator
methods.description: Handles range-based comparison operators such as BETWEEN or NOT BETWEEN.

methods.name: processDuplicatesComparison
methods.description: Evaluates conditions related to duplicate or unique value checks within a specified range.

methods.name: processExpression
methods.description: Handles complex expressions in conditional rules and evaluates their truthfulness.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a formula expression in the context of the calculation engine, returning a boolean result.
